verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents an AI code reviewer that reviews all code changes and suggests fixes on PRs, which supports faster turnaround, but there's no evidence of an explicit 'assign to AI reviewer' workflow, reviewer-assignment mechanics, or independent hands-on confirmation of this specific flow. missing for 10: documentation of explicitly assigning/requesting AI as a PR reviewer (vs automatic scanning), independent/hands-on validation of turnaround improvement.
